target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: People with no basic video editing experience.

prerequisites.required: Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.
prerequisites.recommended: Basic understanding of mobile video editing.

overview.positioning: Master the format that is dominating social media consumption.
overview.short_description: Learn the psychological hooks, editing tricks, and algorithmic strategies to go viral on TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

key_facts.capstone: Produce a series of 5 highly optimized short videos.
key_facts.career_focus: Short Form Video Strategist, UGC Creator

what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Edit fast-paced videos with dynamic captions in CapCut.
Adapt content for the specific nuances of TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts.
Utilize trends and audio strategically without losing brand identity.

why_now.industry_shift: Vertical short-form video is the primary growth driver on all major social platforms.
why_now.ai_impact: Auto-captions and AI editing tools have made production faster, increasing competition.
why_now.business_demand: Brands are desperate for creators who can produce engaging organic short-form content.
why_now.career_opportunity: High demand for UGC (User Generated Content) creators and freelance short-form editors.

learning_outcomes: HOOK: Capture attention in the first 3 seconds.
EDIT: Create fast-paced, visually stimulating edits.
OPTIMIZE: Tailor videos for algorithmic distribution.
CONVERT: Turn short-form views into followers or sales.

business_use_cases.approach: Create organic TikToks demonstrating the product in use.
business_use_cases.output: Viral organic reach leading to sales.

ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Pacing the edit for maximum retention.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Manually correct auto-captions for spelling errors.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Avoid AI voices if building a personal brand.

best_practices: The first 3 seconds determine 90% of the video's success.
Keep visuals changing every 2-3 seconds (pattern interrupts).

common_mistakes.mistake: Starting a video with 'Hey guys, today I want to talk about...'
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Jump straight into the value or the hook immediately.

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to consistently hit high retention rates on short videos.
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of high-performing short videos.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive long-form video -> Clip & edit in CapCut -> Deliver batch.

what_you_will_build: A portfolio of 5 optimized short videos.
A swipe file of high-performing hooks.
final_deliverables: A comprehensive short-form content strategy and video batch.

assessment.criteria: Hook strength, pacing, caption legibility, and algorithmic optimization.

certification.title: Certified Short Video Strategist
certification.criteria: Produce 5 videos that meet retention and editing standards.
certification.verification: Manual review of the video files.

faq.question: Do I have to dance on TikTok?
faq.answer: Absolutely not. Educational, storytelling, and talking-head content performs incredibly well.

faq.question: Can I just cut up my YouTube videos?
faq.answer: Yes, but they need to be reframed vertically and re-edited to match the fast pace of short-form platforms.

modules.module_title: The Anatomy of a Viral Short

lessons.why_it_matters: If they don't stay past 3 seconds, the rest of the video doesn't matter.
Shorts require ruthless efficiency in storytelling.
Identifies exactly where viewers scroll away.

modules.business_application: Writing ad copy for TikTok ads.
modules.expected_outcome: A deep understanding of short-form structure.

lessons.what_is_taught: Shooting vertical video, framing, and leaving pauses for cuts.
lessons.why_it_matters: Good raw footage makes editing faster and better.

lessons.what_is_taught: J-cuts, removing breaths, and adding b-roll/overlays.
lessons.why_it_matters: Maintains viewer attention through pattern interrupts.
lessons.what_learner_does: Edits the rough cut of their videos.

lessons.what_is_taught: Auto-captions styling, sound effects (whooshes, pops), and trending audio.
lessons.why_it_matters: Adds polish and caters to users watching on mute.
lessons.what_learner_does: Finalizes the videos with effects and captions.

modules.business_application: Producing organic content for a brand's social accounts.
